posts.name: Baskaran Nadar
posts.cooked:
This question in the Mock is very ambiguous.
Are we talking about the number occurrences or number of lines having any of the words or both words ?

image1267×575 30.1 KB

Kindly ensure in the Q1 & ET we are careful to clearly articulate what we want.

I was tempted use

grep -oE "ERROR|WARNING" server.log | wc -l

@Afnan_POD

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: The question does say “total count of number of occurrences of the words ERROR and WARNING”. This has only one interpretation that we are looking for something like occ. of ERROR + occ. of WARNING.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Yes this is not framed well. The option we are looking for here is for number of lines of occurrence, assuming an error log will only have one occurrence of error or warning per line. Quiz will have clearer questions
